howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用多智能体协调模式（如 Swarm、Jury）和基础设施组件（如 CoordinationDB、tracked_spawn），用于构建多智能体工作流。
howto.when: 当您需要构建多智能体工作流、了解模式类的构造函数签名、协调数据库模式，或调试智能体跟踪与孤儿检测时触发。

say.text: 用 Swarm 模式并行审查这段代码。
say.note: Claude 会创建 Swarm 实例并执行审查。

say.text: 用 Jury 模式判断这段代码是否适合生产。
say.note: Claude 会创建 Jury 实例并返回投票结果。

say.text: 创建一个 CoordinationDB 来跟踪智能体。
say.note: Claude 会初始化数据库并返回实例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can invoke multi-agent coordination patterns (e.g., Swarm, Jury) and infrastructure components (e.g., CoordinationDB, tracked_spawn) to build multi-agent workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to build multi-agent workflows, understand pattern class constructor signatures, coordination database schema, or debug agent tracking and orphan detection.

say_en.text: Use Swarm pattern to review this code in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude creates a Swarm instance and executes the review.

say_en.text: Use Jury pattern to decide if this code is production-ready.
say_en.note: Claude creates a Jury instance and returns the verdict.

say_en.text: Create a CoordinationDB to track agents.
say_en.note: Claude initializes the database and returns the instance.
